study.question: At fixed history compression and task-conditioned product representation, does replacing the per-block tanh with softsign improve validation click AUC, and do factorial forward/derivative interventions implicate representation values, local gradient weighting, or their interaction?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent averages bounded nonlinear block projections before context-product fusion. Its small gain over global projection (0.000069560 click AUC), followed by unsuccessful finer-event and block-pairing changes, leaves an activation/optimization bottleneck plausible but unmeasured. The slower approach of softsign z/(1+abs(z)) to +/-1 may preserve distinctions among large block preactivations, while its algebraic tail derivative may preserve a different training signal. Cross independently chosen forward values and local derivatives to test these alternatives. Softsign is bounded, odd, and slope-one at zero, but is not uniformly less attenuating in derivative: intermediate-z gradients can be smaller. This study does not presume actual saturation, a beneficial softsign outcome, or a new unified architecture contribution.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local architecture is inherited intact except the projected-block activation and its declared derivative. Context-query tanh and all compression/readout/source gates stay. A native tanh_tanh bridge is included.

Read primary text lines270-335: DIN describes unnormalized target activation and data-adaptive Dice. Retain inherited DIN-style scorer/tower Dice unchanged; the intervention concerns a separate task-branch block projection. This is neither a DIN reproduction claim nor a replacement of Dice.

Pinned benchmark source lines175-200 and439-467 flattens fields/history into tokens and uses normalized paired-stream feedforward updates. No tokenizer, paired stream, SwiGLU or additional mixer is adopted. Only an inherited compressed-block nonlinearity and backward rule change. Original UniMixer paper and straight-through-gradient priority are not verified; no originality claim is made.

inherited_components: All registered parameters and state from g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer, including feature embeddings, action-aware DIN scorer, folded normalization support, task heads, zero-initialized residual adapters and rank16 task context/history product branch
Masked ten-block uf compression, primary-only item/scorer ownership, fixed auxiliary context path, five existing detail summaries and counts

study.proposed_difference: At every task-branch local preactivation z_j=W_h[M*b_j,r], compute t=tanh(z_j) and s=z_j/(1+abs(z_j)) in FP32, choose forward f in {t,s} and local backward g in {t,s}, and return detach(f)+(g-detach(g)). Evaluate each g with a zero edge through the other activation to match intended work across four cells. Use ordinary masked mean of selected forward values before unchanged query-product/RMS fusion. Off-diagonal cells explicitly use surrogate gradients. No new parameters, buffers, loss terms, inputs or RNG. The aggregate tanh diagnostic path remains inherited and zero-weighted; summary_placement is fixed block.
predictions: At common nonzero weights, both tanh-forward cells have identical predictions and both softsign-forward cells have identical predictions; changing backward choice changes only the declared local VJP at that point. The tanh_tanh cell must reproduce the incumbent within native dtype tolerances.

If altered local gradient weighting is useful, tanh_softsign should improve click AUC over tanh_tanh and the derivative effect softsign_softsign minus softsign_tanh should point in the same direction. This would support this derivative intervention, with saturation only a provisional explanation without telemetry.

If altered block values are useful, softsign_tanh should improve over tanh_tanh and softsign_softsign should improve over tanh_softsign. If only the diagonal softsign_softsign improves, retain a forward/backward interaction explanation rather than attributing it to either component alone.

Each cell should keep exactly 32192421 total/31793216 embedding/399205 dense parameters if host construction matches the accepted ancestor. Actual GPU/wall/latency cost is measured. Candidate success requires exceeding the full-protocol incumbent and both source bests at justified cost; a control-only winner is reported according to its actual surrogate-gradient status.
falsifiers: Any failed native masking, source-gradient, state/seed, finite-backward or tanh_tanh parity check invalidates that implementation comparison; execution failure is not a scientific refutation.
No new cell exceeding the tanh_tanh bridge/current incumbent rejects usefulness of this activation intervention under this protocol, without refuting all activation or compression hypotheses.

A derivative swap that consistently hurts in both forward settings contradicts the useful local gradient-weighting prediction. A forward swap that consistently hurts in both derivative settings contradicts the useful value-representation prediction.

A gain absent under paired repetition, smaller than seed variation, explained by broken parity or accompanied by unjustified measured cost is insufficient support. A changed derivative alone is not evidence that training preactivations actually saturated.
Failure to improve the history slices previously degraded by event/pairing variants weakens the proposed link to those observed failures; slice claims remain exploratory.

One seed and many adaptively selected prior trials; repeated bridge results are implementation consistency, not independent replication
Native resource equality and preactivation saturation remain unmeasured
Implicit regularization from changed block magnitudes or derivative weighting, rather than information preservation
Softsign affects signs/magnitude cancellation in the block mean and its direction after product/RMS fusion; the final normalizer does not remove that confound
Adaptive validation selection and inherited one-pass training may favor one trajectory without a generalizable mechanism
Auxiliary AUC deterioration is a substantive tradeoff even if primary click improves; source auxiliary labels have offline user/category/brand semantics
